subject: Culture
title: Sustainable Fashion Movement
description: A short lesson to help you apply Sustainable Fashion Movement.

hook.text: Patagonia's founder told customers 'Don't buy this jacket' in a full-page ad. Sales went up 30%.

buildup.text: Sustainable fashion aims to reduce waste, improve labor conditions, and use eco-friendly materials.

discovery.text: Circular fashion reuses fibers. Renewcell turns old cotton into a pulp that becomes new fabric—a closed loop.

twist.text: Most 'sustainable' collections are 'greenwashing.' Less than 1% of clothing is recycled into new clothing.

climax.text: The real solution isn't better production—it's less consumption. But that conflicts with capitalism's growth model.

punchline.text: The greenest garment is the one you already own.

quiz.question: What percentage of clothing is actually recycled into new clothing?
